description: This file implements the 'Avb' class and related functions for handling Android Verified Boot (AVB) operations, including generating and writing hash footers, info images, and vbmeta images, as well as size enforcement and default instance creation.

classes.name: Avb
classes.description: Class providing methods for Android Verified Boot operations such as adding hash footers, generating info images, creating vbmeta images, and size enforcement.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command-line invocation with parameters and I/O redirection capabilities.

classes.name: SharedFD
classes.description: File descriptor wrapper supporting file operations, I/O redirection, and error reporting.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Template class representing the outcome of an operation, encapsulating success or failure.

methods.name: GenerateAddHashFooter
methods.description: Creates a command to add a hash footer to an image with specified algorithm and key.

methods.name: AddHashFooter
methods.description: Executes the command to add a hash footer to an image.

methods.name: GenerateInfoImage
methods.description: Creates a command to generate an info image from a given image file.

methods.name: WriteInfoImage
methods.description: Generates and writes an info image to a specified output path.

methods.name: GenerateMakeVbMetaImage
methods.description: Creates a command to generate a vbmeta image with chained and included partitions.

methods.name: MakeVbMetaImage
methods.description: Executes the command to generate a vbmeta image and enforces size constraints.

methods.name: EnforceVbMetaSize
methods.description: Ensures the vbmeta image does not exceed maximum size, truncating if necessary.

methods.name: GetDefaultAvb
methods.description: Returns a default singleton instance of the Avb class.

methods.name: CuttlefishKeyAvbComponent
methods.description: Provides a dependency injection component for the default Avb instance.
